record.question: Which of the following is a complete protein?
record.explanation: Answer C: Egg. Egg protein supplies all essential amino acids in useful proportions and is conventionally classified as a complete, high-quality protein; among the listed foods, egg is the clear choice. Reference: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/fdc-app.html#/food-search?query=egg; https://www.nationalacademies.org/documents/embed/link/LF2255DA3DD1C41C0A42D3BEF0989ACAECE3053A6A9B/file/D384C1D61E50BC46B6F5D2B273C82495AEE93CC6A3B7?noSaveAs=1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
